name: quick-commands
description: Short aliases like /t, /l and /b that run your test, lint and build commands.

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: Command /t runs. Leave empty to detect it (package.json, Makefile, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod).

lintCommand.title: Lint command
lintCommand.description: Command /l runs. Leave empty to detect it.

buildCommand.title: Build command
buildCommand.description: Command /b runs. Leave empty to detect it.

typecheckCommand.title: Typecheck command
typecheckCommand.description: Command /tc runs. Leave empty to detect it.
